title: AZACTAM (aztreonam for injection, USP) - FDA Prescribing Information (DailyMed)

claims.text: Aztreonam adult dosing for severe systemic or life-threatening infections is 2 g every 6 to 8 hours.
claims.byte_quote: Severe systemic or life-threatening infections: 2 g, 6 or 8 hours.

claims.text: Aztreonam adult dosing for moderately severe systemic infections is 1 g or 2 g every 8 or 12 hours.
claims.byte_quote: Moderately severe systemic infections: 1 g or 2 g, 8 or 12 hours.

claims.text: Aztreonam adult dosing for urinary tract infections is 500 mg or 1 g every 8 or 12 hours.
claims.byte_quote: Urinary tract infections: 500 mg or 1 g, 8 or 12 hours.

claims.text: Aztreonam pediatric dosing for moderate to severe infections is 30 mg/kg every 6 or 8 hours.
claims.byte_quote: Moderate to severe infections: 30 mg/kg, 6 or 8 hours.

claims.text: Aztreonam pediatric dosing for mild to moderate infections is 30 mg/kg every 8 hours.
claims.byte_quote: Mild to moderate infections: 30 mg/kg, 8 hours.

claims.text: Aztreonam penetrates inflamed meninges, reaching cerebrospinal fluid concentrations of about 3 mcg/mL after a 2 g IV dose.

Aztreonam is active against gram-negative organisms including Haemophilus influenzae (including ampicillin-resistant and penicillinase-producing strains), Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Escherichia coli, Klebsiella, Enterobacter, Serratia, Citrobacter, and Proteus mirabilis.
claims.byte_quote: Citrobacter species, Enterobacter species, Escherichia coli, Haemophilus influenzae (including ampicillin-resistant and other penicillinase-producing strains), Klebsiella oxytoca, Klebsiella pneumoniae, Proteus mirabilis, Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Serratia species.
